description: handle_email_import always fetches new_state from the backend even when all entries failed and created is empty (nothing mutated). This may return a state newer than the actual import mutations if concurrent mutations occurred between old_state fetch and this fetch, producing an incorrect state progression report to the client. Email/set avoids this by only fetching new_state when mutated=true. Trigger: Email/import where all entries fail validation → response reports a new_state that may not correspond to this import operation.
title: Email/import newState fetched unconditionally — differs from Email/set pattern
